svg.title: Hey, I'm Sadra
svg.desc: I like owning things end to end: C++ firmware on an ESP32, the Next.js dashboard that plots what it measures, and the CI that keeps both honest. By day I'm a full-stack developer at Nobears in Rotterdam, shipping and maintaining 15+ WordPress platforms. By night I trade NQ futures and I'm teaching a Python engine to trade them with me.

g.text: I like owning things end to end.
Rotterdam. I ship and maintain 15+ WordPress
